claims.text: Bimetallic catalysts with optimized surface composition will exhibit enhanced HER catalytic activity.
Bimetallic catalysts with optimized surface composition will exhibit enhanced HOR catalytic activity.
Bimetallic catalysts with optimized surface composition will have greater durability during HER and HOR.
Synergistic effects between the constituent metals cause the proposed improvements in catalytic activity and durability.
Surface or interface engineering can optimize the surface composition of a bimetallic catalyst.
Interactions between the different metals modify the electronic properties of the catalyst surface.
Interactions between the different metals modify the geometric properties of the catalyst surface.
The proposed performance enhancement applies under electrochemical operating conditions in an aqueous environment.
Traditional catalysts have limited catalytic activity and durability relative to the proposed optimized bimetallic catalysts.
The hypothesis is not asserted for operating conditions outside electrochemical aqueous environments.
